sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233700 (USACE Bloomington East, Clinton Lake), read 2026-11-06: 'Bloomington East Park includes Cedar Ridge, Hickory/Walnut, and Oak Campgrounds, Ash and Elm Group Camps'; 'Cedar Ridge, Hickory Walnut and Bloomington Beach Day Use area provide amenities like flush toilets, drinking water, showers and a nearby dump station'; notices: check-in 6 pm / check-out 5 pm, 'A vehicle pass is required to use the boat ramps and swimming beach, these are included with your camping fees', 'Overnight occupancy is required for campsites', 'Camping ... for more than 14 days within a 30-day period is prohibited'; rules maxStay 14 (Rolling 30 Days), minHolidayWeekendStay 0 (soft), reservationCutOff 0; phone 785-843-7665.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233700/rates, read 2026-11-06: Peak Season 2026-04-01..2026-10-15 (2027 and 2028 the same): STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20; STANDARD ELECTRIC $26 (30 A, no water); template u20 $28 and CEDAR RIDGE STANDARD ELECTRIC $28 (30 A + water); template u22 $32 (50 A + water); group $100, shelter $75.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id:233700 (305 records), read 2026-11-06: Cedar Ridge 97 (84 at 30 A/water $28, 13 at 50 A/water $32; paved, 59 pull-through, 60 ft); Hickory 96 (43 at 30 A $26, 2 at 30 A/water $28, 4 at 50 A/water $32, 47 non-electric $20; gravel, 20-100 ft); Walnut 88 (32 at 30 A $26, 6 at 30 A/water $28, 50 non-electric $20; 60 ft); Oak 22 non-electric ($20, 45-60 ft); Ash and Elm group camps; no site has a sewer hookup; every site permits RV/Trailer/Tent; 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on Hickory 112-114, 135-139 and Walnut 219-222, 245-250.

https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/availability/campground/233700/month (2026-09 through 2027-05), read 2026-11-06: Cedar Ridge dates run to 2026-10-15 and are Available from 2027-04-01; Hickory, Walnut and Oak are Closed through April 2027 and open 2027-05-01 (last 2026 dates 09-29/09-30); nothing November-March.

Esri World Imagery with the rec.gov site coordinates (38.9100,-95.3780 at 900 m; 38.9060,-95.3750 at 220 m; 38.9053,-95.3765 at 90 m) and USGS 3DEP elevations (epqs.nationalmap.gov), 2026-11-06: Walnut sites 220-222 and 245-249 sit on the lake side of their loop road, 32-45 m from the vegetated shore edge across open mown grass with scattered trees and no road or day use between (site 248 at 270.3 m, water 266.3 m, a gentle slope, no bluff); Hickory 112-139 are 55-80 m back across open grass; Cedar Ridge (north of the county road, by the marina) is set back in fields and woods. Stored pin (38.9098,-95.3764) is the all-site centroid, which falls in woods between Cedar Ridge (584 m N) and Hickory/Walnut (~300 m S).

values.note: Non-electric $20; 30-amp electric $26; 30-amp with water $28 (all of Cedar Ridge's 30-amp sites); 50-amp with water $32.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233700/rates + per-site fee templates (Peak Season 2026-04-01..10-15: NONELECTRIC $20, ELECTRIC $26, u20/Cedar Ridge $28, u22 $32), read 2026-11-06. Non-electric sites in Walnut (60 ft) and Oak (45-60 ft) fit a 23-ft motorhome.

note: USACE Clinton Lake park on the peninsula between the Rock Creek and Wakarusa arms: paved Cedar Ridge by the marina and boat ramps north of the county road, and the gravel Hickory/Walnut/Oak loops on the south shore. Walnut 220-222 and 245-249 sit closest to the water. Camping includes the boat-ramp and beach vehicle pass. --Claude
summary: rec.gov: 303 individual sites (Cedar Ridge 97, Hickory 96, Walnut 88, Oak 22) + 2 group camps; fees 20-26 -> 20-32 (50 A/water $32); season Apr 1-Oct 15 (Cedar Ridge; other loops May 1-Sep 30); 14 nights in 30, same-day booking; 50 A + water, no sewer; facilities from the description. Count 323 -> 303. Walnut 220-222/245-249 sit 32-45 m from the shore over open lawn: waterfront upgrade lead.
flags: WATERFRONT upgrade lead: not waterfront -> lakefront. rec.gov tags 18 sites 'Lakefront' (Hickory 112-114, 135-139; Walnut 219-222, 245-250). Imagery with the per-site coordinates (Esri, 90 m and 220 m frames): Walnut 220-222 and 245-249 are on the lake side of their loop road, 32-45 m from the vegetated shore edge across open mown grass with scattered trees, no road, parking or day use between; USGS 3DEP puts site 248 at 270.3 m and the water at 266.3 m over ~40 m, a gentle slope, not a bluff. Hickory 112-139 are 55-80 m back across open grass (lakeview at least). Clinton Lake is 7,000 acres. Stored value not changed.
SITES count 323 (derived) -> 303 individual sites; rec.gov's 305 records include the Ash and Elm group camps. The '323' in the old note matches no current listing.
FEES 20-26 -> 20-32: the 13 Cedar Ridge and 4 Hickory 50-amp/water sites are $32 (template u22); 30-amp/water $28; 30-amp $26; non-electric $20. Same in every season listed 2026-2028.
SEASON is per loop: Cedar Ridge Apr 1-Oct 15, Hickory/Walnut/Oak May 1-Sep 30 (calendar); written as the widest span with the loop dates in season.note.

SPLIT: Cedar Ridge (centre 38.9150,-95.3770) and Hickory/Walnut (38.9075,-95.3752) are ~800 m apart on opposite sides of the county road, each reached by its own park road; under the ~1 km guideline, so not proposed as a split. Oak is a Hickory loop (rec.gov) 600 m west.

PIN: 38.9098,-95.3764 is the all-site centroid and lands in woods between the two areas (584 m from Cedar Ridge, ~300 m from Hickory/Walnut). Optional move to the Hickory/Walnut core, 38.9075,-95.3752 (~270 m). PHONE 785-843-7665 matches rec.gov (Clinton Lake Project Office). WEBSITE correct.

Amenity tags on rec.gov list 'Sewer Hookup' and 'Laundry Facilities / Washer & Dryer', but no site in the catalog has sewer and the description names no laundry; neither written. SAND: none (the sand beach is the Bloomington Beach day-use area).
